pages.title: Guide the Shuttle
pages.text: Use thread on the loom to load a stack in one action. With an empty hand, hold Use on the highlighted shuttle grip and guide your aim across the loom. Keep holding and reverse direction after the beater packs the row. Four crossings make basic cloth. Release Use, then right-click the loom frame with an empty hand to collect finished cloth. The shuttle remains available for weaving further batches.

pages.title: Comfortable Weaving
pages.text: You may stop halfway and return later. The shed and beater work automatically. Sneak-use retrieves the thread and resets the batch. For less mouse movement, enable loomInputAssistance in firstworks-client.toml, then hold Use on the shuttle. Assisted weaving has the same crossing speed and packing time.
